title: How Anti-Aliasing Removes Stair-Step Edges
description:
A diagonal edge has to fit a square pixel grid, which creates visible steps. This short animation compares sub-pixel coverage, screen-space smoothing and temporal history, then explains why MSAA, FXAA and temporal methods trade cost against softness or artefacts.

Sources:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/direct3d11/d3d10-graphics-programming-guide-rasterizer-stage-rules
https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/cinematic-rendering-image-quality-settings-in-unreal-engine

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
Narration: locally generated British synthetic voice.
Music: original Pulse Gaming synthesis.
